hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; P="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; aec() { ( cd / && python3 -m aec "$@" ); }; aec code-impact --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- --exit-code || { echo 'Telosmith hook: the installed aec has no code-impact --exit-code; install the commit CI pins (tools/aec_upstream.json): pip install "git+https://github.com/eraevous/Telosmith.git@<commit>"' >&2; exit 1; }; aec edges "$P" -o "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl"; echo 'Telosmith hook: could not refresh "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl"; skipped the records check' >&2; exit 1; }; aec check "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" --edges "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" >/dev/null || { aec check "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" --edges "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" 1>&2; exit 2; }; aec snapshot "$P" --rev HEAD -o "$P/.aec/hook-before.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; out=$(aec code-impact "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" "$P/.aec/hook-before.jsonl" "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" --exit-code 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" '(Telosmith: stale/needs_review lines are status changes; structural pointer lines are candidates for attention and change no status. Report-only: the edit already happened.)' >&2; exit 2; }
